readback_blocks.markdown: This preview sets the direction for the simulator’s engines, reentry heat, coastal environment and vehicle detail across six flight scenes. It is an authored concept, not live simulation output or a performance measurement. The implementation will use the existing simulation state and preserve the flight controls.

Use the scene buttons to compare launch, staging, belly flop, entry, landing and catch. Desktop and phone previews show the composition at different sizes; Full and Reduced show which detail can be removed while keeping each scene readable. Owner feedback is recorded separately from engineering acceptance.
